name: Fade Through Color
description: The first clip fades to a color late, the second fades in from it early, with a cross-fade between (black by default, white for xfade fadewhite). Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: color
params.description: Color in the middle of the transition
